title: SourceCitation
description: Field/rule-level provenance pointing to an immutable source document. See docs/data/INDIA_CI_TARIFF_DATA_STRATEGY.md section 5.1 and 9.1.

citation_id.description: Unique citation identifier, referenced from charge_component.source_citation_id and similar fields.

document_id.description: Identifier of the immutable SourceDocument this citation points to.

page.description: Page number in the source document, where applicable.

table.description: Table or schedule identifier within the page, where applicable.

paragraph.description: Paragraph or clause reference, where applicable (e.g. for narrative rules).

quoted_text.description: Optional verbatim excerpt supporting the extracted value or rule.

extraction_method.description: How this value/rule was obtained from the source document.

verification_status.description: Human review status of this citation.

reviewer.description: Identifier of the reviewer who last set verification_status.
